snippet: When deploying to Vercel, the serverless functions inside the api folder are automatically mapped to the /api path. So, in your client-side code, you should adjust the fetch URL to match the correct path for your serverless function.

You can use Serverless Functions to handle user authentication, form submission, database queries, custom slack commands, and more.
